svg.title: Incident Command Lab Azure architecture
svg.desc: Planned Azure deployment with Entra ID, public UI, private gateway and services in AKS and a VNet, ACR, private PostgreSQL and DNS, Key Vault, workload identity and monitoring.
svg.text: Incident Command Lab · planned Azure landing zone
Production-shaped IaC only — cloud apply is unexecuted. Public UI is the sole ingress; gateway and data paths remain private.
AKS subnet · workload identity · non-root pods
Benefits: private data plane · managed identity · immutable release · least-privilege operator access
Azure icon attribution: Microsoft Azure Architecture Icons, Microsoft Corporation, used under the Microsoft Azure architecture icons terms.
This diagram describes Terraform and AKS manifests in this repository; no Azure resources or deployment have been executed.
